title: feat(core)!: retire mergeAuthoredPresentation and axisPresentation, the axis lowering with no caller (objectui#11372)
body:
Fixes #11372

Clause-②: no

## What this does

`@object-ui/core` stops exporting `mergeAuthoredPresentation` and `axisPresentation`, the object-axis chart lowering. Their one caller, plugin-dashboard's `DatasetWidget`, stopped reading `chartConfig.xAxis` / `yAxis` / `series` with objectui#11315 (spec 17.5.0 refuses them on a dashboard widget). Nothing else in this repository called either one.

The commits follow the order in triage's first grade (comment `5929080698`):

1. `8c7052de9`: moves the objectui#10132 axis-title pin onto the react `ObjectChart` tier. It was green before anything was deleted.
2. `5ca85f7f2`: deletes the two functions and their test cases.
3. `95e3d5524`: adds a `@object-ui/core` minor changeset that names the two removed exports, and corrects the pending 10132 changeset's point 2.
4. `8b2b99aa5`: gives the moved pin's recharts size double real types, so the file has no `any` warnings.

Landing site: `packages/core/src/utils/chart-presentation.ts`. The barrel line `export * from './utils/chart-presentation.js';` in `packages/core/src/index.ts` is unchanged, because the module's other exports stay.

## Checks on the card's premises (at `origin/main` `cf38a6cec`, the branch point)

- **There are no production callers.** I ran `git grep -nw` for each name over every tracked file, including `apps/**`, `examples/**` and `content/**`. Outside the test files, the only code hits were the two definitions in `chart-presentation.ts`. Every other hit is a comment, a pending changeset or CHANGELOG history. `apps/**` and `examples/**` have no hits at all. Positive control: the same grep for `mergeAuthoredSeries` finds its import and its call in `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`.
- **`DatasetWidget.comboPresentation.test.tsx` only mentions the name in a comment.** It has one comment hit (`` `@object-ui/core`'s `mergeAuthoredPresentation`. This file pinned that merge.``). It imports `vitest`, `@testing-library/react`, `normalizeChartSchema` from `@object-ui/plugin-charts`, and `../DatasetWidget`. Neither removed name is imported.
- **No surface delivers point 2 any more, so the changeset now says so.** What I measured:
  - The outcome point 2 describes, a locale-map axis title that follows the viewer's language, is true on the `ObjectChart` tier.
  - That tier never went through the core lowering. It passes its own `xAxis` / `yAxis` to `ChartRenderer`, and `normalizeChartSchema`'s `normalizeAxis` resolves the title with `pickLocalized` using the language `ChartRenderer` reads. That behaviour comes from objectui#8943, which is pending in the same release and declared in its own changeset (`chart-heading-follows-viewer-8943.md`).
  - Point 2's own fix (the core lowering forwarding the map through `forwardedI18nLabel`) had one caller. objectui#11315 removed that caller, and this PR removes the lowering, both in the same release.
  - So I moved the pin, which tests that outcome on the surface that still authors its own axes. The changeset text I corrected instead of pointing it at a new surface.

## The 10132 changeset correction

This changeset is pending and publishes verbatim. Five passages changed. The frontmatter did not change: `@object-ui/core: minor` is still justified by point 1, because `resolveDashboardFilterDefs` lives in core.

- The headline used to say two dashboard surfaces now resolve. It now says the filter one does and the axis-title half reaches no surface.
- The intro names the two surfaces and says only the first reaches an author in this release.
- The point-2 sentence ("It now travels verbatim through `forwardedI18nLabel`") is now past tense and says the lowering was removed in the same release.
- In "What an author sees change", I removed the axis-title clause.
- The closing note used to say "Point 2 still holds for `axisPresentation` and `mergeAuthoredPresentation`". It now says point 2 reaches no surface, explains why (objectui#11315 plus this PR), credits the `ObjectChart` axis title to objectui#8943, and names the moved pin.

## The moved pin

`packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.axisTitleLocale-10132.test.tsx` was renamed from `ChartRenderer.axisTitleLocale-10132.test.tsx` and rewritten:

- It renders a real `ObjectChart` with inline rows. Nothing is mocked between the authored node and the DOM.
- The authored `xAxis` / `yAxis` locale maps are written with `en` first.
- It reads the axis titles recharts drew (`text.recharts-label`) at `zh-CN` and at `en`. It also has a plain-string control and an absence control.
- The series carries its own plain label, so a y-axis title cannot reach the DOM as a legend entry instead.
- Recharts 3 draws axis titles in a z-index layer outside the `.recharts-xAxis` / `.recharts-yAxis` groups, so the pin queries the label nodes directly.

**Ablation** (run once, not kept). Done at `8c7052de9` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack), in wrap mode.

- Mutation in `normalizeChartSchema.ts` `normalizeAxis`: `const title = label(raw.title, language);` became `const title = label(raw.title, undefined);`.
- The anchor count went 1 to 0, and the blob went `b3c36b857d5e` to `33d4658031f7`.
- No build was needed: the test imports `./ObjectChart` relatively, so it runs against source.
- Result: `Tests 1 failed | 3 passed (4)`. The failing case was the zh-CN one: `expected [ 'Revenue', 'Stage' ] to deeply equal [ '收入', '阶段' ]`. That is the predicted direction: with no language, `pickLocalized` resolves `en`, so the en, plain-string and absence cases stay green.
- Restore: blob back to HEAD `b3c36b857d5e`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Tests

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/core/ packages/plugin-charts/` at `95e3d5524`: `Test Files 279 passed (279)`, `Tests 4865 passed | 36 skipped (4901)`.
- The moved pin at `8b2b99aa5`: `Tests 4 passed (4)`.
- `type-check` (the hyphenated name echoed as `packages/core type-check$ tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), for `@object-ui/core` and `@object-ui/plugin-charts` at `95e3d5524`: both `Done`. `@object-ui/plugin-charts` again at `8b2b99aa5`: `Done`. `tsc --listFiles` shows each package's `tsconfig.test.json` includes the touched test files.
- Downstream sweep over consumers of `@object-ui/core` (the prefix form, so every package that depends on core): `turbo run type-check --filter='...@object-ui/core' --concurrency=2` at `95e3d5524`. 38 packages in scope, `Tasks: 73 successful, 73 total`. The only later commit touches the moved pin, which was type-checked again at `8b2b99aa5`.
- Reverse check that consumers read the rebuilt `dist/*.d.ts`:
  - The rebuilt `packages/core/dist/utils/chart-presentation.{d.ts,js}` has 0 hits for either name. Control: `mergeAuthoredSeries` has 1.
  - In `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` I changed `  mergeAuthoredSeries,` to `  mergeAuthoredPresentation as mergeAuthoredSeries,` and ran `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-report run type-check`. It failed with `error TS2305: Module '"@object-ui/core"' has no exported member 'mergeAuthoredPresentation'.`
  - Restore was proven: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
  - A first attempt did nothing: its replacement contained the anchor, so `ablation-replace` refused it (anchor count 1 to 1) and did not run the command.

## Gates (all run at `8b2b99aa5`, the final commit)

- `pnpm check:readme-exports`: `✅ check-readme-exports: OK`. The first run reported `@object-ui/cli` and `@object-ui/plugin-ai` as unbuilt (a missing prerequisite, not a red result). I built both and re-ran it.
- `pnpm check:spec-symbols`: `✅ spec symbol derivation: 1449 files scanned ... 0 untriaged collisions`
- `pnpm check:unreferenced-sources`: `OK Every shipped source file in every covered package is reachable.`
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: `✅ 5 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims`: `✅ No pending changeset names a file this change touches.`
- `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`: `✅ No test source names a pending changeset.`
- `pnpm changeset:check`: `✅ No changeset declares a major bump.`
- `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` (report-only): reports the 10132 edit. That edit is deliberate, the card asked for it, and the frontmatter is the same at the base and now.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: `✅ check-control-bytes: OK`
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`
- `check-vi-mock-specifiers` / `-override-shape` / `-inherit`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-type-check-coverage`: all `✅ ... OK`.
- eslint over the three changed source files, with evidence that linting only these files misses nothing:
  1. They are in eslint's own population: `eslint --print-config` returns a config for each one (116, 118 and 119 rules), not undefined.
  2. `--format json` lists 3 files, with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
  3. Other files cannot be affected: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions`, so there is no `project` / `projectService` and no type-aware linting, and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem. A per-file change therefore cannot move another file's verdict.
  The full `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **Comments that still name the two functions.** These belong to objectui#11373's sweep, which runs after this card. I did not edit them here; they are listed so its claim can re-measure:
  - plugin-dashboard `DatasetWidget.tsx`, two places: "(`mergeAuthoredPresentation`) was re-exported here too until objectui#11315" and "half here (#4229, through `@object-ui/core`'s `mergeAuthoredPresentation`)".
  - plugin-dashboard `__tests__/DatasetWidget.comboPresentation.test.tsx`: "`@object-ui/core`'s `mergeAuthoredPresentation`. This file pinned that merge."
  - plugin-report `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`, three places: "`mergeAuthoredSeries` — not `mergeAuthoredPresentation` — because a report's", "`mergeAuthoredPresentation` makes for its own `chartConfig.series`", and "Deliberately NOT `mergeAuthoredPresentation`: that entry point also reads".
  - types `zod/data-display.zod.ts`: "(`DatasetWidget` → `mergeAuthoredPresentation`). Until this declaration both".
- Two of objectui#11373's sites no longer exist after this PR. Its item 3 (the core `chart-presentation.axisTitleI18n-10132.test.ts`) is deleted. Its item 4 (the plugin-charts `ChartRenderer.axisTitleLocale-10132.test.tsx`, "the path a dataset-bound surface actually takes") is now the rewritten `ObjectChart.axisTitleLocale-10132.test.tsx`, and that sentence is gone.
- I deleted `chart-presentation.axisTitleI18n-10132.test.ts` whole. Its other cases tested the two removed functions, and its one remaining case (the series label stays picked) duplicates the `seriesPresentation` case in `chart-presentation.i18nLabel-9038.test.ts`, which stays.
- `.changeset/11315-core-plugin-charts-no-release.md` says `mergeAuthoredPresentation` "keeps its signature and its behaviour". That describes objectui#11315's own diff, and the changeset has empty frontmatter, so it publishes nothing. I left it unchanged.
- plugin-charts has test changes only, so it is not released. The one new changeset covers `@object-ui/core`.
- Outside this repository: objectstack `packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.ts` has two diagnostic strings (`chart-field-unknown`, x-axis and y-axis) whose explanation says `` `axisPresentation` strips it ``. That has been stale since objectui#11315 (the dashboard renderer reads no `chartConfig` axes at all), and the named function no longer exists after this PR. The advice in those messages (delete the key) is still correct. I noted this here and did not file a card. Nobody is known to be picking it up.
- Toolchain: the worktree was installed with `pnpm install --config.engine-strict=false`, because node v22.22.0 is below `jsdom@30`'s engines floor. No tracked files changed as a result.
